meaning.en: Queen seated on the glorious lion-throne

explanation.en: She is the sovereign of the glorious lion-throne. A lion-throne is the seat of supreme royal power; to call her its sovereign is to say that no power stands above hers.

inner.en: The lion is an emblem of power that devours, so commentators read this name as her power of dissolution. Inwardly, what she dissolves is the false sense of a separate self.

story.en: Commentators read the first three names together as her three cosmic acts: as Mother she creates, as Empress she sustains, and as Queen of the lion-throne she dissolves. This third name is the power that dissolves.
